title: Changing Political Dynamics Challenging the Electricity Industry Business Model
content: Here we are in 2026, witnessing several political and economic narratives shaping how the electric industry will operate for the next several years, or possibly decades. The role of artificial intelligence (AI) in improving decision-making and operational efficiency tops the list of emerging technologies that will significantly impact how the utility business operates.
author: Paul A. DeCotis
